Subject: Tenant scaffold & invite cadence — handoff for AcmePay onboarding

Monica / Dev —

Handoff for AcmePay (deal ACME-2026-0047). Sales has completed the acceptance criteria and legal has signed the SOW. AcmePay is aiming for a week-3 soft launch (traffic gated) and want the admin invites + API seeding completed ahead of that. Quick context: they will start with a single prod tenant, two staging projects, and expect SAML SSO later in Q4.

What I need from the implementation team to kickoff:
- Confirmation of a target window for API key seeding + admin invite (preferably next-week window 9/1–9/3).
- A concise role matrix (owner/admin/developer/viewer) we will seed — attached is the sales-delivered list (minimal).
- Any preflight checks (IP allowlist, KMS, compliance docs) we should ask AcmePay for up front.

Elena, looping you in so you can confirm the admin roster and any SSO/KMS constraints.

Attachments: acmepay_onboarding_manifest.xlsx (export from CRM)

Thanks — I recommend a short kickoff call Tues morning so we can lock windows.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Soto <elena@acmepay.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tenant scaffold & invite cadence — handoff for AcmePay onboarding

Thanks Jonas —

Confirmed, we can do the key seed and admin invites during the 9/1–9/3 window. Proposed plan (high level):

1) Preflight (day 0) — request: admin email list, preferred project names, IP allowlist CIDRs (if any), KMS requirements.
2) Seed (day 1) — create tenant scaffold, provision two staging projects + prod namespace, seed API keys for env-specific service accounts, upload role matrix.
3) Invite (day 2) — send admin invites, validate login flows, confirm token rotation policy.

I've attached a blank role matrix CSV and will fill with the sales list once Elena confirms admins.

Questions for Elena:
- Do you want us to create shared service accounts for ingestion + embeddings, or will AcmePay create them and hand keys to us?
- Are any of the admin accounts corporate SSO-only (we'll send invite metadata but not local passwords)?

I'll schedule a 30m kickoff on Tue 9/1 09:30 PT with a calendar invite pending — if that doesn't work, propose alternatives.

Attachments: tenant_role_matrix_v1.csv

— Monica
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Elena Soto <elena@acmepay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AcmePay IT Ops <it-ops@acmepay.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 13:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Tenant scaffold & invite cadence — handoff for AcmePay onboarding

Thanks team — quick answers below: 

- We'll have three initial admins: me (elena@acmepay.com), Rajesh Gupta (rajesh.gupta@acmepay.com), and Mia Torres (mia.torres@acmepay.com). Please make Rajesh the primary admin for billing visibility.
- We prefer Redwood to create the shared service accounts for ingestion/embeddings and rotate keys once handed off.
- SSO: we plan to enable SAML in Q4; for initial invites please create local accounts (we'll map to SSO later).
- KMS: we have a managed Key Vault with a customer-managed key (CMK). We need guidance on integration; can you send the KMS integration checklist?

Availability: Tue 9/1 09:30 PT works for a short sync.

-Elena

Great — keeping this short with the technical notes we need to execute the seed: 

1) API key seeding: we can generate environment-scoped keys for prod/staging. Proposal: ephemeral seed keys with TTL 30 days, then customer rotates to long-lived service keys. We will drop keys into the tenant's secrets store and send a secure link to AcmePay for retrieval.
2) KMS integration: we need the CMK key-id and the service principal allowed to wrap/unwarp keys. If AcmePay prefers not to provide a CMK yet, we can use Redwood-managed encryption until Q4.
3) IP allowlist: please provide CIDRs for any office/VPN egress IPs that must have console access.

I'll prepare a short execution playbook (runbook) and upload to the implementation folder before the 9/1 kickoff.

— Dev
